summary: Chat Message: the Sender gains status="queued" — a turn sent while the agent is still running the last one, captioned in muted ink like Sending ("Queued — runs after this turn"), with statusText required by the type. The Receiver's static block caret is removed: per the Chat status behaviour sheet the turn's one mark is the Streaming matrix in a status row under the text (ChatProgress form="streaming"), placed by the caller. isStreaming still withholds the actions row.

migration.manual: BREAKING: the `chat-message-caret` part no longer renders. While streaming, put `<ChatProgress form="streaming" label="…" />` as the receiver's last child and remove it when the answer settles.
